EVAL-P-M2-S1.title: Define Specialty Match Accuracy Schema and Contract
EVAL-P-M2-S1.description: Define structured schema for specialty match output including NUCC codes, normalized match score (0–1), confidence level, contributing signals (regex/vector), and explanation fields.

EVAL-P-M2-S2.title: Implement Specialty Match Accuracy Logic
EVAL-P-M2-S2.description: Compute match accuracy between user condition and provider specialties using NUCC taxonomy by aggregating dual-pipeline outputs (regex + vector), deduplicating codes, and producing a normalized score with confidence weighting.

EVAL-P-M2-S5.title: NUCC Normalization and Explainability Layer
EVAL-P-M2-S5.description: Normalize NUCC specialty codes and generate human-readable explanations linking condition-to-specialty matches, including handling multi-specialty overlap and ambiguous mappings.

EVAL-P-M2-S3.title: Expose Specialty Match Accuracy via Evaluate Care Facade
EVAL-P-M2-S3.description: Integrate specialty match accuracy output into provider evaluation response and expose via evaluate_care_facade for downstream chat/tool consumption.

EVAL-P-M2-S4.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Specialty Match Accuracy
EVAL-P-M2-S4.description: Create unit tests for scoring, normalization, and explainability, plus integration tests validating end-to-end flow from specialty identification through evaluate care facade response.
